notes.title: Full Version is Released Today!
notes.notes: We are extremely glad to say that Shadow Blade: Reload is no longer in Early Access and you can get the full version of the game from today. The game will be heavily maintained by the developers from now on.

notes.title: Full Version Release Date Set.
notes.notes:
The full version will be released on August 10th! The Digital Deluxe edition will also be available including a comic book, the art book and the game original sound track.
Becoming a Ninja is at your fingertips!

notes.title: Version 0.85 with big enhancements!
notes.notes:
The update for version 0.85 is available with big enhancements!

2 New Chapters with Hardcore/MasterClass Difficulties (Dungeon, Dojo) Added
New Boss Fight
New Enemies (drones)
Chapter 5 Art (hugely) Improved
Many storytelling, gameplay and visual Improvements for the first 4 Chapters
Shadow Challenge Mode Added (contain first 10 shadow challenges)
Visual Loading Hints Added
Hints to Pause menu
Gallery Added
Credits Added
Some Control Improvements
Scoring System Updated
Various Bug Fixes

notes.title: Big Update!: Version 0.8
notes.notes:
The BIG update is here! This update introduces you to the game story!

In this version:
 - Game story for the first three chapters
 - Enhanced game menus
 - Highly polished level structures
 - Enhanced game graphics
 - New combat features for Kuro
 - The first two boss fights
 - Enemy introduction cutscenes
 - New music
 - Full leaderboard integration for the new levels
 - Game hints
 - 3 Difficulty levels for the game
 - Various bug fixes

notes.notes:

Version and level number indicator 
Patch Notes window added 
(Dash + Down) now perform dive attack too

Hide mouse cursor ingame
Fixed a Bug that would cause cloth being visible after death

notes.title: Update 0.6.4
notes.notes:
Here are the enhancements for this build, major improvements for using the Gamepad controllers are added:

Shuriken Hit bug fix
Option menu dropdowns bug fix
Use XBoxController as the default controller scheme
Option menu controller and keyboard navigation fix 
Level selection menu chapter navigation bug fixed
Added Shift and Controller shoulder buttons as shortcuts for changing chapters 
Kuro Scarf fixed both in game and menu 
Dojo Editor Items Icons
Music/Sfx Mute Setting bug fixed
